description: This file defines the DestroyPurgeStrategy class, which extends a base PurgeStrategy class and provides a purge method to remove entity records related to a specific employee number in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DestroyPurgeStrategy
classes.description: A class responsible for purging entity records related to a specific employee, extending the generic PurgeStrategy base class.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Removes entity records associated with the provided employee number from the entity manager.
